text:
The wind at the summit howled, tearing at Lara’s jacket as she collapsed onto the jagged rock, her chest heaving with the effort of the ascent. Below her, the world was a patchwork of emerald forests and silver rivers, stretching out into a horizon that seemed to touch the sky. She closed her eyes, letting the cold air fill her lungs, feeling a profound sense of peace settle over her, a quiet victory against the gravity that had tried to hold her back.

As she opened her eyes to take in the final details of the landscape, a shadow flitted across her vision. A common crow landed on a nearby outcrop, its feathers sleek and glossy against the bright backdrop of the sky. The color of a common crow is black.
